column1: # Reviewed 2026-10-19 (S0-07) for the monorepo at 86eeb33d against the 2026-09-01 checkpoint
# b404312 of the former server repository, both built with the same current Go toolchain and these exact flags
# `go tool nm -size` attribution of the file-backed symbols (+9028 KB of the growth; the rest is
# pclntab and type metadata that scale with code) names the aws-sdk-go-v2 S3 client for
# backup and object storage (+2483375, plus sts +170003, signin +173340, ssooidc +61785),
# httpapi (+476398), protobuf runtime (+386484 impl, +98879 filedesc), httpsnoop
# (+78149), go-github (+64257) and miekg/dns (+86305) bytes, i.e. features added since
# the checkpoint (teams, billing, browser access, ENV, self-host, support reports,
# object storage). Updating a size requires this attribution.
